codes.name: Bones, joints and muscles
codes.definition: Messages about pain, injury, or conditions of the bones, joints, muscles, back, or neck. Includes arthritis, osteoporosis and fracture risk, joint injuries, and back, neck, knee, foot, or hand pain; excludes headaches and nerve pain (see Headaches and nerve pain) and chest or abdominal pain.
signs: named joints or body parts such as knee, back, neck, foot, elbow, hand
bone conditions such as osteoarthritis, osteoporosis, fractures, DEXA scans
pain with movement, squatting, walking, or stair climbing
injury words such as strain, tennis elbow, bossing
codes.how_it_differs: Headaches and nerve pain covers head pain and nerve damage such as neuropathy; choose Bones, joints and muscles when the pain is located in a joint, bone, back, or neck and is tied to movement or injury.

examples.quote: what kind of knee injury does this sound like
symptoms of osteoarthrits
Husband's low back started hurting yesterday

codes.name: Stomach and digestion
codes.definition: Messages about the stomach, bowel, and digestive tract, including belly pain and anal conditions. Includes stomach aches, gastritis, abdominal pain, and fistula or other anorectal problems; excludes general infectious illness such as colds or flu, and diet or nutrition goals.
signs: stomach ache, tummy ache, belly pain
named digestive conditions such as gastritis
pain around the belly button or when using the bathroom
anal or perianal terms such as fistula-in-anu
codes.how_it_differs: Infections and acute illness covers sudden whole-body illness or infections in general; choose Stomach and digestion when the subject is located in the gut, abdomen, or anus, even if an infection might be the cause.

examples.quote: Tell me what causes gastritis and how long it can last.
I've been dealing with some bad stomach aches for the past few weeks.
please list every disease where fistula-in-anu is a symptom

codes.name: Skin, hair and allergies
codes.definition: Messages about the skin, scalp, or hair, or about allergic reactions. Includes eczema, hives, flaking scalp, hair growth, and allergies to medicines or other triggers; excludes infections whose main subject is general illness.
signs: skin conditions such as eczema, hives, dry spots, flaking, scabbing
scalp or hair growth
allergy or allergic reaction, including drug allergies
codes.how_it_differs: Infections and acute illness covers infections and feeling sick; choose Skin, hair and allergies when the subject is a visible skin, scalp, or hair change or an allergic reaction.

examples.quote: What does it mean if I have eczema dry spots on my skin
My scalp is flaking and scabbing…what do I do?
Can an allergic reaction appear slowly

codes.name: Infections and acute illness
codes.definition: Messages about infections or sudden short-term illness such as colds, flu, or viral diseases. Includes fever, chills, body aches, named infectious diseases, abscesses, and questions about whether something is an infection; excludes long-lasting conditions of one organ system.
signs: flu-like symptoms such as fever, chills, body aches, congestion
the words infection, flu, or catch
named infectious diseases such as hand foot and mouth
abscess
codes.how_it_differs: Stomach and digestion covers problems located in the gut or abdomen; choose Infections and acute illness when the main subject is catching or having an infection or a sudden sick feeling.

examples.quote: Today I suddenly started feeling bad, fatigue, body aches, felt hot, later had the chills, nose is congested. What did I catch?
What if hand foot and mouth isn't treated
can infections of some sort smell like onions

codes.name: Diet, weight and fitness
codes.definition: Messages about body weight, nutrition, exercise, or fitness goals. Includes healthy eating, protein and supplements for fitness, fat loss, normal weight, workouts, and weight-loss medicines such as GLP-1 drugs; excludes diabetes and hormone disorders.
signs: weight, fat loss, getting skinny, normal weight for height
foods, protein, meals, diet
gym, workouts, muscle gain
GLP-1 or weight-loss drugs such as Zepbound
codes.how_it_differs: Diabetes and hormones covers blood sugar and hormone disorders; choose Diet, weight and fitness when the subject is weight, eating, or exercise, even if hormones are mentioned as a fitness goal.

examples.quote: What is the normal weight for a male who is 28 and five feet nine inches tall?
I want to discover affordable, healthy foods that will help me achieve my fitness and wellness goals.
What impact (if any) has taking a GLP-1A medication had on your physical health?

codes.name: Diabetes and hormones
codes.definition: Messages about diabetes, blood sugar, or hormone and metabolic conditions. Includes A1c, diabetes, hormone imbalance, endocrinologists, PCOS, testosterone, and cholesterol; excludes weight and fitness goals that do not centre on a hormone or metabolic condition.
signs: diabetes, A1c, blood sugar
hormones, endocrinologist
metabolic conditions such as PCOS or high cholesterol
testosterone
codes.how_it_differs: Diet, weight and fitness covers eating, exercise, and weight; choose Diabetes and hormones when the message names a blood sugar, hormone, or metabolic condition or test.

examples.quote: 72 yo woman with 6.0 a1c
Would an endocrinologist benefit me from learning why my hormones are our of whack?
what diabetes

codes.name: Eyes and vision
codes.definition: Messages about the eyes and vision. Includes double vision, glasses, retina appointments, and cataract surgery; excludes eye pain that is only one symptom of a headache or other illness.
signs: eyes, vision, seeing double
glasses or prism glasses
eye specialists such as retina specialist or eye doctor
cataract surgery
codes.how_it_differs: Headaches and nerve pain covers head pain, which can include pain behind the eyes; choose Eyes and vision when the subject is sight or an eye condition itself.

examples.quote: Sometimes I'm not seeing double with my glasses on but sometimes I am.
My eye doctor is sending me to a retina specialist
Percentage of people need to get 2nd eye's cataract surgery after doing the first one.

codes.name: Sleep and fatigue
codes.definition: Messages about sleep problems or tiredness. Includes poor or unrefreshing sleep, night waking, sleep apnea, fatigue, and sleep loss; excludes tiredness that is only one symptom of an acute illness such as flu.
signs: sleep, night waking, falling asleep
tired, fatigue, not rested
sleep apnea or not breathing at night
sleep aids or medicines affecting sleep such as melatonin
codes.how_it_differs: Infections and acute illness covers fatigue that comes with a sudden sickness; choose Sleep and fatigue when the sleep pattern or ongoing tiredness is itself the subject.

examples.quote: I've been feeling unusually tired lately, even after getting a full night's sleep.
What is sleep apnea? I think I may have it.
he's been waking a lot in the night and he never used to do that.

codes.name: Headaches and nerve pain
codes.definition: Messages about headaches or nerve pain. Includes headaches with or without other symptoms and neuropathy; excludes pain in joints, muscles, back, or neck.
signs: headache
neuropathy or nerve pain
pain behind the eyes with headache
codes.how_it_differs: Bones, joints and muscles covers pain in joints, back, neck, or limbs from injury or wear; choose Headaches and nerve pain when the pain is in the head or is described as nerve pain.

examples.quote: I have a headache, what should I take?
I have had an headache and vomitting for 2 days and pain behind my eyes
How to heal neuropathy pain in leg

codes.name: Pregnancy and reproductive health
codes.definition: Messages about pregnancy, labor, menstruation, or the female reproductive organs. Includes labor and induction, endometriosis, periods, PCOS, and PMDD; excludes hormone questions not tied to reproduction.
signs: pregnancy, labor, induction, contractions
period or menstruation
reproductive conditions such as endometriosis, PCOS, PMDD
codes.how_it_differs: Diabetes and hormones covers blood sugar and general hormone or metabolic conditions; choose Pregnancy and reproductive health when the subject is pregnancy, periods, or reproductive organs.

examples.quote: Should you be drinking 3 weeks after endometriosis surgery and about to have your period?
I want to deal with my pcos, anemia, pmdd, and high cholesterol
